description: Standardized tool definitions for a self-improving AI Agent Harness (compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini function calling).

tools.name: terminal_exec
tools.description: Execute a shell command in the local or containerized workspace and return stdout, stderr, and exit code.

tools.name: browser_fetch
tools.description: Navigate to a URL, extract readable content or structured elements, and return status.

tools.name: delegate_task
tools.description: Spawn an isolated sub-agent (or headless CLI worker such as Claude CLI) to perform parallel research or coding tasks.

role.description: Short role description for the sub-agent

tools.name: schedule_cron_job
tools.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off task to run autonomously and deliver output to a gateway or log file.

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Save a durable fact, user preference, or learned system quirk into Semantic Memory (memories/memory.md).

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Retrieve relevant context from Semantic Memory (top-k plain-text match) and Episodic Memory (SQLite state.db).

tools.name: skill_manage
tools.description: Create, update, read, or list procedural skills stored as Markdown files under skills/<category>/<name>/SKILL.md.

tools.name: sales_agent_add_knowledge
tools.description: MCP tool to inject additional knowledge (e.g., booking links, pricing, policies) into a deployed Sales Representative Agent.
